findings.title: Attachment returned alongside error leaks resources
findings.message: When the titlebar attach fails, the function returns both a non-nil attachment and an error. Callers conventionally ignore the value on error, so the already-created accessibility bridge and text input are never closed. That leaks native resources and leaves the AX attachment registered.
findings.suggestion: On error, close the attachment yourself (call attachment.Close()) and return nil, err, as the earlier error paths do.

finding.title: Corrupted assignment line breaks owner setup
finding.message: The line `owner.[REDACTED]` is not valid Objective-C, so the file fails to compile. It presumably should set the token and window (owner.token=token;owner.window=window;). Without it, the owner has a zero token and nil window, so actions go nowhere and detach cannot restore the window.
